Initial release of editor-background skill.

- Instantly replaces video backgrounds with a clean studio backdrop using AI.
- Works with MP4, MOV, AVI, and WebM files up to 500MB—no green screen required.
- Simple workflow: upload a video, describe your desired background, and receive an edited download in about 30–60 seconds.
- Supports keyword-based actions for uploading, exporting, credits, and timeline status.
- Automatic session/token management and clear error messaging for common issues.
- Ideal for content creators seeking fast, professional-looking results without advanced editing tools.
